name: MS-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: Thompson is a long-tenured incumbent in a D+11 district
Republican challenger raised only ~$45k with no outside spending

model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Thompson: a D+11 seat, incumbency, and a large cash advantage over a barely funded challenger. Markets price this at 97% Democratic, consistent with a Safe D rating.
model.watch: Any late outside spending or polling showing a tighter race would be the first sign of movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Bennie Thompson seeks another term in a Mississippi district that leans Democratic by about eleven points. He enters with roughly $1.4 million on hand, while Republican Ron Eller has raised under $50,000 and shows no outside support. No general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the outlook rests on fundamentals and market pricing.

Prediction markets give Thompson about a 97% chance of winning, and the expected margin sits near twenty points. An independent candidate on the ballot is minimally funded and unlikely to alter the outcome. The race is rated Safe Democratic.
